tasks.label: Run API
tasks.command: infisical run -- uv run uvicorn api.main:app --reload

tasks.label: Run Tests
tasks.command: infisical run -- uv run pytest tests/*

tasks.label: Make Migrations
tasks.command: infisical run -- uv run tortoise -c api.db_migrations.TORTOISE_ORM_MIGRATIONS makemigrations

tasks.label: Run Migrations
tasks.command: infisical run -- uv run tortoise -c api.db_migrations.TORTOISE_ORM_MIGRATIONS migrate

tasks.label: Run Benchmarks
tasks.command: PYTHONPATH=. infisical run -- uv run python benchmark/run_benchmarks.py

tasks.label: Docker Run (API with Infisical)
tasks.command: docker build -t factor-api . && export INFISICAL_TOKEN=$(infisical login --method=universal-auth --client-id=${input:infisicalClientId} --client-secret=${input:infisicalClientSecret} --plain --silent) && docker run --rm -p 8000:8000 --env INFISICAL_TOKEN factor-api
